name: LanguageSwitcher
description: Compact language selector: a current-language trigger that fans out the other locales as a button group.

ariaRequirements: each option has an accessible name (aria-label)
a11y.reviewedNote: Verified 2026-06-02: role=group + aria-label; trigger exposes aria-expanded/aria-controls/aria-current; options are native buttons with aria-label. Escape and outside-click close; reduced motion swaps the fan for a fade. KeyboardToggle play function drives open-via-trigger / close-via-Escape and passes axe; Default/Example/Playground pass axe with test:error; light + dark verified in Storybook.
